method.diagnostic_limits: audit verifies the recorded oracle evidence, not a GPU rerun; diagnostic work counts do not isolate timed CPU costs
method.interval: approximate 99.583333% whole-block paired percentile bootstrap with Bonferroni 0.05/12
method.physical_equivalence: equal ordered action rows excluding rule attribution, lifecycle semantics, link bytes, misses, managed reservation and peak
method.receipt_checks: recompute raw evaluator JSON bytes, canonical result, and worker request digests; match lease, frozen inputs and journal
method.strict_gate: all 12 paired aggregate gains exceed the preregistered scenario margin
method.trial_score: sum of the two case medians from three elapsed_ns samples each

scope.agent: same-domain engine transfer with actual v7 heldout case reuse
scope.others: cross-scenario transfer on existing case sets
scope.runtime: real CUDA fixed text-derived block sparse attention

training.selection_rule: lowest feasible train score within each source and scenario, tie by slot ID
